annotations.title: Search email-reading rules (hacks) other people shared

description: Searches the hacks people share with the community, by sender (like chase.com) or name. With trackId, what fills that track instead: TrackerHacker's ready-made services for its topic, then the community's email hacks that fill it. Each has its fields, how many people use copies, how many of those read a message in the last 30 days (working) or stopped matching (stopped), its stage (production: working for 5 people or more, a ready-made; beta: working for 2 or more; alpha: so far only its maker's emails, so check it reads the person's own emails, with test_hack, before relying on it), and an example message. Before building a hack for a sender, look here: a shared one that's working saves the person an AI suggestion. With communityHackId instead, one hack in full: its template and all its examples, to test_hack on the person's own messages before use_community_hack.

communityHackId.description: One hack in full, from an earlier search.

query.description: A sender's domain or address, or words in the hack's name. Leave out for the most used.

trackId.description: Only what fills this track's topic: the ready-made services first (turn_on_ready_hack), then community email hacks with the mapping that fills it (use_community_hack).
